points.text: Is the Arabic text easy to read at phone size?
Does the layout read right to left, with the start of each row on the right?
Do the arrows and chevrons point the right way for Arabic?
Do the numbers read correctly, with digits and symbols in the right order?
Does the line with +966 55 123 4567 keep the number whole and in order?
Does the row of six code boxes read as one group with a clear first box?
Does the countdown show 0:45 with its digits in order next to the Arabic word for resend?
Is the verify button easy to spot and its label readable?
Are the title and the sent-code line aligned to the same edge?
Do the Arabic letters join properly in the title and the sent-code line?
Is the spacing even and the page tidy, with nothing cramped, overlapping or out of line?
